pages.title: Scrollture
pages.content:
# Scrollture

An endless, swipeable feed of Bible verses from all 66 books.

- **For You**: a mix of well-loved passages and deep cuts from every corner of scripture
- **Books**: binge any book in order, shuffle it, or read it chapter by chapter
- **Themes**: endless scroll on love, anxiety, strength, hope, wisdom, and more

Scrollture needs JavaScript to run. See [About](/about) for details on the translation.

pages.title: About
pages.content:
# About Scrollture

Scrollture turns the whole Bible into an infinite feed. Swipe to see passages from all 66 books, double-tap to like, and tap through to read any passage in context or binge a book from start to finish.

## Translation

Scripture text is the **Berean Standard Bible (BSB)**, which has been dedicated to the public domain. Learn more at [berean.bible](https://berean.bible).

## Your data

Likes, streaks, and reading progress are stored only in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
